name: ASHES
paper: From Benchmarks to Production: Transferring Time Series Anomaly Detection Methods for Electricity Production Monitoring. 42nd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE)
description: ASHES (Anomaly Scoring-based on Historical ExtremeS) is a feature-based approach introduced in the context of the TAMIS framework. The latter is a scalable and interpretable system that analyzes daily production time series to automatically detect anomalous days based on deviations from historical patterns learned from past data. Designed for human-in-the-loop workflows, TAMIS surfaces top-ranked anomalies through an automated daily newsletter, enabling efficient expert review and continuous monitoring. ASHES is one of the detectors TAMIS uses.
